text:
Alex (support): FYI acme-prod reporting p99 spike ~6s starting 14:02 UTC and intermittent 503s with auth errors during burst window. Customer says it started after a marketing blast.
Priya (oncall): ack. Can you paste the curl repro and any request IDs? Also which Dedicated pool?
Alex (support): pool=dedicated-eu-west-3, sample req id=rcpt-7f3a-9b2c, curl below.
Alex (support): ```curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer <tok>\" -d '{"input":"short"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate```
Sarah (support): attaching excerpt from their logs: "attach_timeout=120s, attach_latency=3.8s, backend_status=503, auth_err=invalid_token" repeated.
deploy-bot: [alert] autoscale.go: scaleup_delay=45s, attach_retries=3, pool=dedicated-eu-west-3
Priya (oncall): looks like scale-up lag + auth fallthrough. Any recent changes to heartbeat or minpool?
Marco (eng-platform): we rolled a change yesterday reducing min_pool to 1 for cost savings in that region. Could cause coldgpu exposure on bursts. Also seeing a handful of failed image pulls at 13:58 UTC.
Alex (support): customer confirms surge ~14:01-14:10, many concurrent requests from a campaign. They hit priority queue but it overflowed.
Priya (oncall): immediate mitigation suggestions: 1) bump min_pool to 3 in eu-west-3 2) temporarily enable priority window for acme-org 3) short-term token refresh fallback (if auth fails, retry with service token)
Marco (eng-platform): agreed. I'll trigger a quick min_pool bump and check warmup health. Also enabling fast-fallback to next-compatible model variant to reduce attach time.
Marco (eng-platform): running: `kubectl patch config/autoscale -n infra --type=json -p='[ {"op":"replace","path":"/regions/eu-west-3/min_pool","value":3} ]'`
deploy-bot: [info] rollout started for autoscale config in eu-west-3 by Marco, change-id=cfg-2026-346
Sarah (support): sent customer a note: "we're applying a temporary capacity bump and enabling a priority window; please hold off on further retries for 10min." :thumbsup:
Alex (support): customer reports p99 dropped to ~1.2s after the bump, 503s reduced. Still seeing a few auth_err spikes.
Priya (oncall): follow-ups: - get attach logs from dedicated-eu-west-3 for 13:50-14:15 - verify image-pull errors and registry throttling - add an alert on rapid min_pool evictions - create a short playbook for priority-burst customers
Marco (eng-platform): pulling attach logs now, will check kernel image pull errors and kube events. Suspect registry rate limit + cold GPU image unpack causing extra latency.
Marco (eng-platform): quick note: we also saw heartbeat mismatches in the autoscaler when multiple attach attempts overlapped; adding randomized jitter to attach retries in the next patch.
Priya (oncall): Can support owners draft a one-pager with repro steps and the exact curl + token rotation steps so CS can hand to customer?
Sarah (support): on it. I'll include sample requests, expected headers, and the temporary workarounds we applied.
incident-bot: Incident I-2026-115 opened for Dedicated-eu-west-3 burst-attach-latency; severity=P2; assignee=Marco
Alex (support): closing loop: customer happy for now, asking for postmortem and cost impact.
Marco (eng-platform): will follow up with root cause: mix of reduced min_pool + registry pull failures + auth token fallthrough on retry. Next steps: revert min_pool to safer baseline, add registry backoff, implement attach jitter, and publish short playbook for Support.
Priya (oncall): thanks team. I'll schedule a quick sync tomorrow 10:30 UTC to finalize remediation and customer comms. :calendar:
Sarah (support): thanks all.
Alex (support): resolved for now.
